title: Bitcoin ETF inflows surge as retail and institutional demand
content:
TL;DR: Bitcoin spot ETFs are experiencing a significant surge in inflows, marking a pivotal moment as traditional capital increasingly seeks refuge in decentralized hard money. This institutional validation arrives as the Bitcoin network itself maintains robust security, with a current difficulty of 146.47 T and a strong hashrate of 882.70 EH/s, underscoring its foundational resilience against global economic uncertainties. For transactors, this means continued network stability and a heightened need for strategic fee management as demand for block space grows, reinforcing Bitcoin's role as the ultimate monetary sovereignty tool.

The Report

As of February 04, 2026, at 07:02 UTC, the Bitcoin network continues its unwavering operation, currently standing at Block Height 934,950. The real-time hashrate registers at a formidable 882.70 EH/s, a testament to the computational power dedicated to securing the network. This robust figure, while below the approximately 977 EH/s seen in late January, still represents a massive global commitment to Bitcoin's integrity.
